title: A Network Space runs chapters: member Spaces, shared membership, the network home and the roll-up report open to Network

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-15, the Collective / Network split (one owner running many groups is a Network). PR 2 of 6, the gates step.

detail: isChapterParentPlan (lib/collective/member-spaces.ts) is the one rule for which plans hold same-owner children: network, plus collective and nonprofit_collective so existing Collectives keep what they bought. The member Space plan inheritance (and with it shared membership), the member Space manager, the network home (collectiveNetworkOpen) and the private roll-up report all read it. A Network holds NETWORK_PLAN.includedChapters (10) chapters with no self-serve extra quantity; past ten is a quote. Extra-Space billing and cross-listing stay Collective only. The billing editor says chapters for a Network and member Spaces for a Collective. Migration 20270346009000 replaces set_collective_member_space so the database admits a network parent with ten chapters and never lets a Network become a child.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const m=fs.readFileSync('lib/collective/member-spaces.ts','utf8');const n=fs.readFileSync('lib/collective/network.ts','utf8');const r=fs.readFileSync('lib/collective/network-report-policy.ts','utf8');const sql=fs.readFileSync('supabase/migrations/20270346009000_network_chapters.sql','utf8');const bad=[];if(!/isNetworkPlan\(plan\) \|\| isCollectivePlan\(plan\)/.test(m))bad.push('Network does not hold chapters');if(!m.includes('NETWORK_PLAN.includedChapters'))bad.push('no ten-chapter capacity');if(!n.includes('isChapterParentPlan(parent.plan)'))bad.push('no Network home');if(!r.includes(\"'network'\"))bad.push('no Network report');if(!sql.includes(\"'network'\"))bad.push('database refuses Network chapters');if(bad.length){console.error('SCAN-960: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
